domain.name: abstract Fano point-line incidence
domain.description: The finite projective plane PG(2,2), represented only by two opaque seven-element sorts and their incidence relation.
domain.source_semantics: A point-line pair is incident exactly when its two opaque members occur in one declared incidence row. Raw identifiers carry no order, coordinate, probability, or target meaning.

admitted_inputs.generator: Every ordered pair (point, line) from the two declared sorts.

equivalence.raw_encoding_equivalence: Two encodings are equivalent exactly when a sort-preserving incidence automorphism carries one point-line pair to the other.

automorphisms.definition: All independent point and line permutations that preserve the declared incidence relation.

decision_type.name: IncidenceDecision
decision_type.rule: Return incident iff the input pair belongs to the declared incident relation.

compiler_visible_semantics: the induced incidence automorphisms and equivalence classes
compiler_forbidden_semantics: answer label stored as an input field

preexisting_source_authority.independence_fence: The frozen object is the abstract unlabeled incidence quotient already recovered and banked by Issue 011. It does not reuse the FIPS Event catalogue, habitat supports, hidden FFF labels, learning targets, or any OT preparation representation.
